additions.text: A0
She died at a hundred and two and she is calm
She was nineteen and she does not accept being here
A nurse: she saw many people die; now it is her turn
The floor shows your face at every age
Angel of the gate: he was never human
Angel who counts everyone who arrives
She lies on the grass and looks at the clouds
Its water shows a happy memory
She runs even in Heaven
Postwoman angel: she brings the letters of the living
Angel who guides the newcomers
He reads the diary he wrote at fifteen
A huge book open in the air
She does not know if she should drink from the river of forgetting
She looks for her book and finds it almost empty
Mother and daughter: twenty years without speaking
Married for fifty years; they still argue
Between the columns, you can hear the light
She watches her children on Earth
He hugs his dog, who was waiting for him
A cook: he carries trays to the banquet
Angel who watches the Earth from above
“Abandon all hope here”
She still tries to call her office
Her number is 9,999,999,999
He sells second chances
She looks for a mirror to see herself
From here you can see the volcanoes
Court usher: he has heard every excuse
Accused of a small lie that grew
For years he has not dared to get on the boat
It crosses a river of fire
She walks in a square for ever
A messenger: he carries lists of excuses
He does not leave his open cage
He cries in the cage of guilt
He has been angry with his brother for thirty years
Lucero’s secretary
Guard of the throne; she is bored
He buys memories at a good price
She runs away from her cage and always comes back
Hell. Follow the circles of fire: someone is waiting in each one.
